message.reasoning:
I need to make a decision in this Monopoly turn.

I have $56 and am on Pennsylvania Railroad. I have two jail cards. Nearly all properties are mortgaged. Only Ventnor Avenue and Marvin Gardens remain unmortgaged.

The opponent has $1,681 and owns almost all properties with hotels. I paid $200 rent on Pennsylvania Railroad.

Only Mediterranean Avenue can be unmortgaged. It costs $33, which I can afford. The other properties cost more than I have. Unmortgaging it would yield only $2 rent.

Unmortgaging Mediterranean is too expensive for the $2 rent. I will keep it mortgaged.

Mortgaging Ventnor or Marvin would give cash but destroy my only rent threats. Ventnor base rent is $22 and Marvin Gardens $24. With a full yellow monopoly they would pay $44 and $48.

Mortgaging Ventnor or Marvin would yield $130 and $140, but I would have no income properties left. The opponent has hotels on light blue, pink, and green. I am in a desperate position with only $56 cash and two jail cards. Next turn I will roll from Pennsylvania Railroad.

Rolling a 10 from Pennsylvania Railroad lands on B&O Railroad. That costs $200, which I cannot pay with only $56.

I can cover the $200 B&O Railroad rent by mortgaging Ventnor and Marvin for $270 total. Most other rolls from this space are safe. I will not pre-liquidate properties.

Trading away my dark blue or orange monopolies would be suicide. The opponent already owns hotels on light blue, pink, and green. They do not need dark blues to build hotels. I will not trade sets.

The opponent has no incentive to trade. They already own hotels and cash, so they do not need my jail cards or monopolies. Completing a brown monopoly would only yield minor rent. No trade can help me win.

Unmortgaging the dark blue properties is impossible. Park Place costs $192.50 to unmortgage and Boardwalk costs $220. I cannot afford either. The opponent's hotels are too strong for me to survive by chance alone.

I will end the turn. The $56 covers the $20 rent on Illinois. Mortgaging Ventnor and Marvin now would eliminate their rent threats before I need the cash, so I will not do it.

Mortgaging Ventnor and Marvin now would give me $270, leaving $126 after the B&O Railroad rent. I could then unmortgage Mediterranean for $33 and possibly other properties. The orange monopoly would pay $28 to $32 per turn if fully unmortgaged.

Unmortgaging all three orange properties costs $308. With $326 cash, I would have $18 left and gain a $28 to $32 orange monopoly rent. That is more than the yellow base rent of $22 to $24. The opponent is currently on St. James Place. Rent is paid when landing, not while sitting. They will roll off this space next turn.

The opponent's next roll from St. James Place could land on Ventnor or Marvin, but the resulting rent is only $22 or $24. Unmortgaging the orange monopoly would yield a single $32 hit, which is too small to offset the loss of yellow income and the $18 cash shortfall.
